sources.title: Qwen3.8-4B-Distill-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-4B-Distill-GGUF is a quantized GGUF format distribution of a knowledge-distilled 4-billion-parameter language model developed by empero-ai. The underlying base model is a full-parameter distillation of Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B into the Qwen3.5-4B architecture, trained on approximately 45,000 curated teacher traces from Empero's internal distillation datasets.
